title: Peace Time
description: Allows enabling no‑PvP days. When the selected time ends, PvP is automatically reactivated for all players.
body:
# Peace Time – PvP Server Management Mod
Take full control over when war begins on your server.

## Description
**Peace Time** lets you manage your server’s progression by adding configurable peace periods before PvP becomes active.  
Perfect for SMP servers that want to prevent early PvP, organize structured events, or run automatic peace/war cycles without any manual intervention.

---

## Key Features

- **Configurable Timer**  
  Set exactly how many Minecraft days players remain safe. Displays remaining time in `hours:minutes:seconds`.

- **Automatic Peace/War Cycles**  
  Create infinite repeating cycles such as:  
  `5 days peace → 3 days war → repeat`.

- **Smart PvP Control**  
  PvP is automatically disabled during peace and enabled when war begins.

- **Optional Boss Bar**  
  Shows a real-time countdown visible to all players.

- **Customizable Notifications**  
  Titles and chat messages for every phase transition.

- **Data Persistence**  
  All data is saved automatically on server restart.

- **Multi-Dimension Support**  
  Peace/war timers operate simultaneously across all dimensions.

---

## How to Use

### 🔸 Normal Mode (Single Timer)

`/peacetime set 7 `
 → Sets 7 days of peace

`/peacetime get`
→ Shows remaining time

`/peacetime reset`
→ Resets the timer

### 🔸 Cycle Mode (Automatic Peace/War)
`/peacetime schedule enable 5 3` 
→ Starts a cycle: 5 days peace + 3 days war

`/peacetime schedule status`
→ Shows current phase and remaining time

`/peacetime schedule disable`
→ Stops the cycle

---

## Advantages

- Plug-and-play installation
- Zero configuration required
- Simple and intuitive commands
- Fully automated cycles
- Highly customizable
- Data persists between restarts
- Works across all dimensions

---

## Use Cases

- SMP servers preventing early PvP  
- Scheduled war events  
- Seasonal preparation/war phases  
- Roleplay servers with narrative cycles
